## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

[All Early Phase Clinical Services][140]

BIOANALYTICAL SCIENCE SPOTLIGHT

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

[Bioanalytical Sciences Overview][148]

CLINICAL RESEARCH SPOTLIGHT

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

[Other Expertise Areas][156]

## What Sets Us Apart

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

Altogen Labs provides over 50 xenograft cancer animal models (biodistribution, PK/PD, imaging
studies). We offer assistance in choosing the best model suitable for clients experimental goals.
Animal handling and maintenance at our facility is IACUC-regulated and GLP-compliant. We provide
detailed experiment procedures, health reports and experimental data.

Xenograft Animal Service
New slide

Altogen Labs provides A-to-Z RNAi in vivo delivery services: custom si/miRNA liposome encapsulation,
chemical modification, in vitro validation, in vivo tissue-targeted delivery. Assays include:
oligonucleotide accumulation (TaqMan), target mRNA (RT-PCR) and protein expression levels (WB and
ELISA).

In Vivo siRNA Delivery
New slide

Stable cell lines over-expressing a protein of interest, or RNAi construct targeting a gene of
interest, are powerful research tools for the production of recombinant antibodies, drug screening,
and gene function studies. Altogen Labs provides service of stable cell line development completed
in 28 days.

Altogen Labs provides over 50 xenograft cancer animal models (biodistribution, PK/PD, imaging
studies). We offer assistance in choosing the best model suitable for clients experimental goals.
Animal handling and maintenance at our facility is IACUC-regulated and GLP-compliant. We provide

New slide

Altogen Labs provides A-to-Z RNAi in vivo delivery services: custom si/miRNA liposome encapsulation,
chemical modification, in vitro validation, in vivo tissue-targeted delivery. Assays include:
oligonucleotide accumulation (TaqMan), target mRNA (RT-PCR) and protein expression levels (WB and
ELISA).

In Vivo siRNA Delivery
New slide

Stable cell lines over-expressing a protein of interest, or RNAi construct targeting a gene of
interest, are powerful research tools for the production of recombinant antibodies, drug screening,
and gene function studies. Altogen Labs provides service of stable cell line development completed
in 28 days.

Global Antibody Drug Industry Development BlueBook (Frost & Sullivan)
**Key Insights**
The industry is undergoing a rapid transformation driven by next-generation modalities, globalized
markets, and upstream technological innovations.
* **Market Structural Shift:** Monoclonal antibodies drive steady growth, but ADCs and bispecifics
  are rapidly accelerating, reshaping the market with higher-value innovations.
* **Chinese Market Globalization:** China is actively expanding globally, evidenced by a surge in
  high-value cross-border license-out deals.
* **Technology-Driven Efficiency:** Advanced discovery engines—exemplified by Cyagen's HUGO-Ab
  platform and AI algorithms—are streamlining candidate screening, optimizing molecular design, and
  localizing the upstream supply chain.
* **Oncology-Focused Innovation:** R&D pipelines remain heavily concentrated on high-incidence
  malignancies like non-small cell lung cancer, utilizing complex modalities to combat clinical
  resistance.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action

* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and

* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and

* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.

* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable

## Who This Ebook Is For
* Pre-seed and seed founders preparing fundraising materials
* Small business owners applying for bank loans or grants

* **Format:** Ebook (PDF)

* **Delivery:** Instant download by email after purchase
* **Works on:** iPad, Kindle, mobile, desktop - any device that opens PDFs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long should a business plan be?

20-40 pages is typical for investor plans, 15-25 for lender plans. The ebook covers the differences
in depth required for each audience.

### Do I need a full business plan or just a pitch deck?

Both serve different audiences. The ebook covers when a pitch deck is sufficient (most early-stage
VC conversations) and when a full plan is required (bank loans, grants, accelerators).

### How do I write the financial projections section?

The ebook walks through bottom-up financial modelling, key assumptions and the projection format
lenders and investors expect.

### Is there an AI tool for business plans?

Yes - Avvale's AI Business Plan Generator. The ebook covers how to use AI to draft a plan and the
editing layer required to make it investor-grade.

### How is this different from the bespoke business plan service?

This ebook teaches you to write your own plan. The bespoke service is a fully written plan by Avvale
consultants - we typically build these for live fundraising rounds where investor-grade depth is
required.

## Built by Avvale Consulting

Avvale Consulting has helped 300+ founders across 30+ countries raise capital and grow their
businesses since 2015. This ebook is the productised version of the knowledge we share with paying
clients - so you can apply it without the consulting bill.

## Write an investor-ready business plan from scratch

Most founder business plans never see an investor because they were written for the wrong audience
using the wrong template. The Business Plan Playbook Ebook is the founder-friendly guide to writing
a serious plan that actually gets read - covering structure, financial section depth, market sizing
and the narrative arc investors and lenders look for.

By the end you will have a business plan structure that works for both fundraising and operating,
plus the templates to fill it in.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and
  everything in between.
* Prompt Pack Get inspired with prompts that help you articulate your business goals, mission,
  vision, and strategies clearly and persuasively. Perfect for crafting investor-ready plans or
  improving internal alignment.
* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and
  templates to guide you through writing each section of your business plan.
* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.
  Follow this roadmap to ensure no detail is overlooked.
* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable
  Word-Document for your convenience.
* Financial Plan Template Create a solid financial foundation for your business with a detailed
  financial plan template. Includes revenue projections, expense tracking, cash flow analysis, and
  break-even calculations, all tailored for startups and small businesses. This template is
  available in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) to suit your needs.
* Aspiring entrepreneurs looking to bring their ideas to life.

## Who This Ebook Is For
* Pre-seed and seed founders preparing fundraising materials
* Small business owners applying for bank loans or grants
* Side-hustlers formalising a real business plan for the first time
* Consultants writing business plans for their clients

## Format & Instant Delivery
* **Format:** Ebook (PDF)
* **Language:** English
* **Delivery:** Instant download by email after purchase
* **Works on:** iPad, Kindle, mobile, desktop - any device that opens PDFs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long should a business plan be?

20-40 pages is typical for investor plans, 15-25 for lender plans. The ebook covers the differences
in depth required for each audience.

### Do I need a full business plan or just a pitch deck?

Both serve different audiences. The ebook covers when a pitch deck is sufficient (most early-stage
VC conversations) and when a full plan is required (bank loans, grants, accelerators).

### How do I write the financial projections section?

The ebook walks through bottom-up financial modelling, key assumptions and the projection format
lenders and investors expect.

### Is there an AI tool for business plans?

Yes - Avvale's AI Business Plan Generator. The ebook covers how to use AI to draft a plan and the
editing layer required to make it investor-grade.

### How is this different from the bespoke business plan service?

This ebook teaches you to write your own plan. The bespoke service is a fully written plan by Avvale
consultants - we typically build these for live fundraising rounds where investor-grade depth is
required.

## Built by Avvale Consulting

Avvale Consulting has helped 300+ founders across 30+ countries raise capital and grow their
businesses since 2015. This ebook is the productised version of the knowledge we share with paying
clients - so you can apply it without the consulting bill.

With over 2 billion data points and an ever-growing source of proprietary analytics, it supports programs from target to biomarker discovery.  ## **Custom Preclinical & Clinical Platforms** Champions accelerates oncology research by offering state-of-the-art analytical solutions including GCLP High Complexity Flow Cytometry, Next Generation Sequencing, and Histology.    At Champions Oncology, we are dedicated to driving breakthrough advancements in cancer treatment through cutting-edge oncology research solutions. With extensive expertise across all therapeutic modalities and unique proprietary platforms and datasets,  we partner with global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to provide clinically relevant preclinical models and advanced clinical specialty testing solutions. We offer unparalleled insights that accelerate the path from discovery to clinical success. Through scientific excellence, we focus on meeting the challenges of drug development by providing innovative solutions that ultimately improve patients’ lives. ### **ON DEMAND WEBINAR** ### Cracking KRAS: Decoding Sensitivity and Resistance to Pan-RAS(ON) Inhibition Across ### Patient-Derived Tumour Models ### ### [ Watch Now ][81] ### **CYTO 2026 POSTER** ### Development of Robust Evaluation of T Cell Subsets with T-Cell Activation In a 3D Tumor–PBMC ### Co-Culture Model Enables Reliable Phenotyping and Cytotoxicity Assessment ### [ Download Now ][82] ## Latest News & Events Don't miss Champions' exciting developments in our latest [Press Releases][83] and book a meeting at an upcoming global scientific conference or Champions event.   ## **Latest Resources** Dive into Champions' newest Case Studies, Infographics, Webinars, and White Papers to uncover how to accelerate your oncology research programs. ## Supporting the full drug discovery and development continuum

Basic Research

Basic research is the foundation of all scientific breakthroughs, improving our understanding of
biology and advancing our knowledge of the life sciences. From an expansive selection of research
animal models and human-derived products to the management of genetically modified models and health
surveillance, your next breakthrough starts here.

and services.

Human Immune and Stem Cells

sourcing provider.

Genetically Engineered Animals and Services

Genetically Engineered Animal Models and Services (GEMS) team helps you select, customize, and
maintain the right mice for your research. Services for genetically engineered animals include mouse
and rat model creation, breeding, genotyping, and mouse embryo and sperm cryopreservation.

][19]

Discovery

Drug discovery is a challenging journey. Too often, a novel compound’s road to market is delayed –
or blocked entirely – by limited resources or expertise. With a comprehensive multi-modality
discovery service portfolio and a staff of hundreds of scientists, we have the scientific excellence
and technological capabilities to support our clients throughout the drug development life cycle.

discovery, hit id, hit-to-lead, lead optimization, safety, and toxicology are all managed by the

## Supporting the full drug discovery and development continuum

### No matter where you are in your drug development journey, we can provide you with a wide range
### of products, models, services and guidance that are tailored to your specific needs.

Basic ResearchDiscoveryPreclinical TestingClinical DevelopmentManufacturing and
CommercializationScientific and Regulatory Guidance

Basic Research

Basic research is the foundation of all scientific breakthroughs, improving our understanding of
biology and advancing our knowledge of the life sciences. From an expansive selection of research
animal models and human-derived products to the management of genetically modified models and health
surveillance, your next breakthrough starts here.

[Explore the Portfolio][16]
[

Research Models and Services

Support your basic research with help from the leading global supplier of laboratory animal models
and services.

][17][

Human Immune and Stem Cells

The leading developers of cutting-edge cell therapies and basic research trust us as their cell
sourcing provider.

][18][

Genetically Engineered Animals and Services

Genetically Engineered Animal Models and Services (GEMS) team helps you select, customize, and
maintain the right mice for your research. Services for genetically engineered animals include mouse
and rat model creation, breeding, genotyping, and mouse embryo and sperm cryopreservation.

][19]

Discovery

Drug discovery is a challenging journey. Too often, a novel compound’s road to market is delayed –
or blocked entirely – by limited resources or expertise. With a comprehensive multi-modality
discovery service portfolio and a staff of hundreds of scientists, we have the scientific excellence
and technological capabilities to support our clients throughout the drug development life cycle.

[Discover the Offerings][20]
[

Integrated Drug Discovery

Reduce time to clinic by up to a year with an integrated drug discovery approach in which target
discovery, hit id, hit-to-lead, lead optimization, safety, and toxicology are all managed by the
same project team.

][21][

Discovery Pharmacology Studies

*In vitro* to *in vivo* translation is difficult, costly, and often fails. Advance your discovery
research with our translationally focused approach across a range of therapeutic areas including
oncology, neuroscience, and immunology.

][22][

Antibody Discovery Services

Antibody discovery services designed with your IND in mind. Comprehensive solutions, tailored to
your unique vision for your next antibody therapeutic.

][23]

Preclinical Testing

Determining a drug’s safety profile is perhaps one of the most critical stages of the drug
development pathway. Complications and inefficiencies with preclinical studies can create costly
delays. Using state-of-the-art technologies in a global network of facilities, our skilled
scientists execute individual studies and custom testing programs that are designed with a client’s
goals in mind.

[Learn What’s Possible][24]
[

Non-GLP Integrated Toxicology

Two primary study offerings are available for non-GLP toxicology studies for lead optimization and
preclinical development.

][25][

IND-enabling Programs

Successfully initiate and complete your IND-enabling program while meeting regulatory expectations
with our unique range of IND-enabling studies.

][26][

Carcinogenicity Studies

Our carcinogenicity studies include expert support in project design, model selection, and *in vivo*
and *ex vivo* data for final submission.

][27]

Clinical Development

Clinical trials are an exciting stage of drug development, representing the fruition of years of
hard work. By working with our scientists, you can ensure cost-effective execution and front-load
clinical timelines as early as the preclinical phase.

[Find Out More][28]
[

Biologics Testing Solutions

Our tailored global testing and manufacturing services support clients throughout the biologic
development cycle, from discovery through preclinical and clinical studies to marketed product
release.

][29][

Biologics Contract Manufacturing

Accelerate the development of your biopharmaceutical from concept to cure with our CGMP compliant
biologics contract manufacturing services. 

][30][

Rightsource^{SM} – Biologics Insourcing Solutions

A flexible testing platform that can be deployed where and when you need it, whether it’s located at
your facility, one of our satellite labs, or even within the walls of the many Charles River
facilities itself.

][31]

Manufacturing and Commercialization

Our development, manufacturing, and testing support services enable our clients to produce safe and
compliant products. Our scientists, technicians, and expert support teams can provide the insight,
advice, and tools needed to streamline the manufacture and release of safe products for patients in
need.

[Get the Details][32]
[

Cell and Gene CDMO Solutions

Fastrack your cell and gene development and manufacturing with our end-to-end scalable solutions
from early stage-research and testing through commercial release.

][33][

Biologics Testing and Manufacturing Solutions

Navigate seamlessly throughout the biologic development cycle, from early concept to market-ready
with our tailored, CGMP global testing and manufacturing solutions.

][34][

Microbiology Quality Control Solutions

Elevate your contamination control strategy and accelerate production with confidence. Our rapid,
accurate, and compliant microbial testing solutions optimize your QC workflow.

][35]

Scientific and Regulatory Guidance

Navigating the changing regulatory landscape is an ongoing challenge for many involved in the
development, approval, and manufacture of pharmaceuticals and medical devices. We've built a unique
global team of scientific advisors whose expertise spans various drug modalities, therapeutic areas,
and key stages in the drug development process.

[Meet the Experts][36]
[

One Step Manufacturing

One Step by Charles River is a comprehensive, tailored suite of CRO drug discovery and development
services in target discovery, lead optimization, development chemistry, GMP, drug product
development and CMC strategy.

][37][

Fast Lane

Expedite your investigational new drug (IND) application with Fast Lane Paradigm. Learn how to
reduce white space between studies and accelerate time to clinic for you INDs.

][38][

IND-Enabling Studies Toolbox

Charles River can conduct an investigational new drug (IND) study from start to finish, and offers
stand-alone studies needed for IND-enabling submissions. Our IND experts have expertise in all major
therapeutic areas, including medical devices and gene and cell therapies.

][39]

Global Antibody Drug Industry Development BlueBook (Frost & Sullivan)
**Key Insights**
The industry is undergoing a rapid transformation driven by next-generation modalities, globalized
markets, and upstream technological innovations.
* **Market Structural Shift:** Monoclonal antibodies drive steady growth, but ADCs and bispecifics
  are rapidly accelerating, reshaping the market with higher-value innovations.
* **Chinese Market Globalization:** China is actively expanding globally, evidenced by a surge in
  high-value cross-border license-out deals.
* **Technology-Driven Efficiency:** Advanced discovery engines—exemplified by Cyagen's HUGO-Ab
  platform and AI algorithms—are streamlining candidate screening, optimizing molecular design, and
  localizing the upstream supply chain.
* **Oncology-Focused Innovation:** R&D pipelines remain heavily concentrated on high-incidence
  malignancies like non-small cell lung cancer, utilizing complex modalities to combat clinical
  resistance.

**Key Insights**
The industry is undergoing a rapid transformation driven by next-generation modalities, globalized
markets, and upstream technological innovations.
* **Market Structural Shift:** Monoclonal antibodies drive steady growth, but ADCs and bispecifics
  are rapidly accelerating, reshaping the market with higher-value innovations.

* **Technology-Driven Efficiency:** Advanced discovery engines—exemplified by Cyagen's HUGO-Ab
  platform and AI algorithms—are streamlining candidate screening, optimizing molecular design, and
  localizing the upstream supply chain.
* **Oncology-Focused Innovation:** R&D pipelines remain heavily concentrated on high-incidence
  malignancies like non-small cell lung cancer, utilizing complex modalities to combat clinical
  resistance.

save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,

16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

> “Everything we do, we do with passion – and we do it for life.”

Stefan Dräger, Executive Board Chairman

## News, highlights & events

—
[Vista-300-3-2-DMC-104650]

#### Introducing the new Vista 300 patient monitor

An essential patient monitor for adults, paediatrics, and neonates. It is part of a scalable patient
monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access
and optimise your workflows.

[Learn more][87]
[caregivers-use-sterile-gear-to-help-prevent-infection-3-2-d-3511-2018]

#### Infection Prevention & Control in Hospitals

Our products are always designed with minimal parts and infection prevention in mind – helping you
to improve workflow efficiency and reduce the risk of such infections in your hospital.

[Learn more][88]
[NICU-Scene-3-2-D-6667-2018]

#### Continually evolving care for newborns

As Your Specialist in Acute Care, we continue developing outstanding technology and delivering
innovative design that is focused on your newborns.

[Learn more][89]
[xnode]

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

#### Dräger X-plore 8300

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

#### Suraksha Parmo Dharma

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[Learn more][92]
[IN-CSR-PCVC-3-2]

#### CSR Initiative Supported by Dräger Safety India

Dräger Safety India proudly announces its successful CSR initiative with PCVC, supporting survivors
of domestic and interpersonal violence, highlighting our commitment to protecting and saving lives.

[Learn more][93]
